title: Multi-Domain Empirical Bayes for Linearly-Mixed Causal Representations
abstract: arXiv:2603.18404v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Causal representation learning (CRL) aims to learn low-dimensional causal latent variables from high-dimensional observations. While identifiability has been extensively studied for CRL, estimation has been less explored. We use empirical Bayes (EB) to estimate causal representations from multiple domains whose differences reflect interventions in a shared causal model. Multi-domain CRL poses a simultaneous inference problem suited to EB. Here, we propose an EB $f$-modeling algorithm that improves the quality of learned causal variables by exploiting invariant structure within and across domains. Specifically, we consider linear measurement models with interventional priors induced by an acyclic latent causal model with known graph and intervention targets. translated_title: 线性混合因果表示的多领域经验贝叶斯方法
translated_abstract: 因果表示学习（CRL）旨在从高维观测数据中学习低维因果潜变量。尽管因果表示学习的可识别性已被广泛研究，但其估计方法却较少被探索。我们使用经验贝叶斯（EB）方法从多个领域中估计因果表示，这些领域之间的差异反映了共享因果模型中的干预。多领域因果表示学习构成了一个适合经验贝叶斯的同时推断问题。在此，我们提出了一种经验贝叶斯 f-建模算法，通过利用领域内和领域间的不变结构来提高学习到的因果变量的质量。具体而言，我们考虑了具有干预先验的线性测量模型，该先验由具有已知图结构和干预目标的无环潜因果模型所诱导。我们开发了一种基于因果结构化得分匹配的 EM 风格算法。在合成数据和半合成单细胞数据的实验中，我们提出的方法实现了更准确的……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于经验贝叶斯 f-建模的多领域算法，通过因果结构化得分匹配并利用领域内与领域间的不变结构，从线性混合观测中更准确地估计因果潜变量。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an empirical Bayes f-modeling algorithm for multi-domain causal representation learning, which leverages causally structured score matching and invariant structure within and across domains to more accurately estimate causal latent variables from linearly-mixed observations.
